System_Information.Title: Streb 2021 - Experiment A6
System_Information.Description: Breakthrough on zeolite 13X (Streb & Mazzotti 2021, experiment A6: 45 C, 10 bar, 20 cm3/s, binary CO2/CH4 50:50) into a column full of helium, with the decks' calibration on A3 and this experiment's flow factor (README, "Calibration on A3"). The digitised outlet mole fractions and the five centre-line thermocouples are bound to the deck (Experimental Data).
System_Information.Author: Sam Affleck
